top.title: Aaron Rodgers releases new statement via Al Michaels, says he went on 'Pat McAfee Show' after Steelers barred him from team facility
top.description: Aaron Rodgers made quite a few waves on his way out of the Pittsburgh Steelers earlier this week. He had more to say during their first game without him. Prime Video broadcaster Al Michaels relayed a text message he got from the former MVP during the Steelers’ game against the Denver Broncos, which served to rebut some of his critics and explain why he handled things the way he did. Michaels read the text messages early in the fourth quarter of the Black Friday game. Al Michaels reads a message he received from Aaron Rodgers earlier today. pic.twitter.com/4ijFB2wFnN — NFL on Prime Video (@NFLonPrime) November 27, 2026 First, Rodgers complained about the idea he has committed some sort of locker room faux pas by airing out dirty laundry involving Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy, whom Rodgers accused of a number of shortcomings during an appearance on “The Pat McAfee Show” on Wednesday: “A lot of talk about the sanctity of the locker room … The code or sanctity exists to protect the integrity of the locker room, not to provide immunity from accountability for its leadership.” That rebuttal could be aimed at a number of notable figures. Rodgers’ quarterbacking peer Tom Brady said “ The sanctity of an NFL locker room, it's a very sacred place. ” Rodgers’ former coach Mike Tomlin said it was sad “to see laundry aired out that way in a public forum, those are things that kind of run counterculture to professional football.” Steelers owner Art Rooney II said, “ In general, I think, historically, what's in the locker room stays in the locker room. That's the way it's always been. That's the way it should be as far as I'm concerned. ” Former Steelers quarterbacks Terry Bradshaw and Russell Wilson both expressed their disapproval . Aaron Rodgers still has something to say after the NFL's loudest divorce. AP Photo/Terrance Williams As for how things played out with the Steelers, it’s known that Rodgers made some sort of ultimatum — reportedly that he wanted to call plays on offense or be released — and the Steelers opted to announce his benching late Tuesday night then release him Wednesday after he aired his grievances against McCarthy. Rodgers claimed he got no communication from McCarthy until his benching was announced, and that he only appeared on McAfee after the Steelers barred him from their facility: “They took this public, never heard from the head coach, then they leak at 11:00 p.m. They also barred me from the facility. That's why I went to McAfee." Odds are this won’t be the last time we hear about Rodgers on this. Meanwhile, his former teammates defeated the Broncos 27-5 on Friday behind a dominant defensive performance . Rodgers did appears to receive a shout-out from wide receiver DK Metcalf, though .

Alas, that wasn’t the case and Denver was shellacked on the road by Pittsburgh 27-5. Here are some instant reactions from today’s matchup. Murphy’s Law was in full effect in Broncos’ embarrassing loss Anything that could have possibly went wrong for the Broncos this afternoon did. For all the talk about the Steelers potentially coming out flat , the exact opposite transpired. It was Denver who came out of the gate absolutely lifeless. Quarterback Bo Nix played the worst game of his career. We have seen him perform bad in the elements the past two seasons. However, today’s awfulness was on an entirely different level. Early on, Nix had a fumble that resulted in a touchdown for the Steelers in the first quarter. As I wrote earlier today, winning the turnover battle was going to be mission critical for the Broncos. They certainly wound up on the wrong side of that equation. On defense, even Patrick Surtain II had an off day, and those rarely ever happen. Overall, I’m still quite perplexed at how off kilter the Broncos looked. top.title: Henry Cejudo reflects on passing of Eddie Cha: ‘Master Cha, you will always be remembered’
top.description: Henry Cejudo and Eddie Cha worked closely for years Henry Cejudo is going to miss Eddie Cha. On Wednesday, Cha, the famed striking coach at Fight Ready in Glendale, Ariz., died suddenly of unknown causes . During his career, Cha worked with some of the biggest names in MMA, but arguably his most successful student is former UFC flyweight and bantamweight champion Henry Cejudo. Speaking with MMA Fighting’s Mike Heck ahead of RAF 15, Cejudo reacted to the sudden passing of his longtime coach. “It hurts,” Cejudo said. “It’s sad. I don’t know if you guys remember when Kobe died, Kobe Bryant—obviously he wasn’t Kobe Bryant, known by the world, but the people that loved him, something just doesn’t sit right. … 53 years old. Great man, great husband, great coach, great friend, and it’s just too bad. He’s too young to leave. But we never know when it’s our turn. Life is life. It’s just unfortunate. It’s very sad. … “I know Eddie would want us to continue, keep pushing forward, and I’m going to honor Eddie this weekend with this victory.” Cha was a significant figure in Cejudo’s MMA career, shepherding the Olympic wrestling champion’s transition to MMA striking. Cejudo gave one example of just how much of an impact Cha had on him. “He brought a lot of the traditional Tae Kwon Do style of ‘Yes, sir. Yes, mister.’ Just respecting your elders type of thing,” Cejudo said. “And he would always—very kind in that sense, and he would give you the small little bow, whether you’re an elder, he would open the door for you, things like that. You could tell he comes from a really good tradition of how he was raised through martial arts. “I think the biggest thing with Eddie, he came up with the game plan when I beat Dominick Cruz. We started getting the feel—and you could hear it, too. You can see when I gave him a shoutout right after the fight. They gave me the post-fight mic with Joe Rogan, and I was just like, ‘Hey man, that was all Eddie Cha,’ and it was, because he was just smart. He was like, ‘Dominick moves his upper body a lot; he’s hard to hit up top, but Henry, look what he leaves behind: his legs.’ So we kicked the crap out of his legs. So that was something that I really started to do because of Eddie. “I think everybody has an impact in your life, and Eddie is definitely one of them. I’m just heartbroken, still. But I know what Eddie would want. He’s like, ‘Dude, keep moving forward.’ He was there when my sister died; he gave me great advice, and things like that. Guys were always there. Condolences to him and his family and everybody that loved him. Eddie Cha, Master Cha, you will always be remembered.” Cejudo competes in the main event of RAF 15 on Saturday, defending his lightweight crossover title against past MMA opponent Song Yadong.

top.title: Mizzou Heads Into December on 6-Game Win Streak After UAPB Win
top.description: Nov 27, 2026; Columbia, Missouri, USA; Missouri Tigers forward Bryson Tiller (15) shoots a layup against the Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions during the first half of the game at Mizzou Arena. Mandatory Credit: Denny Medley-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Arkansas-Pine Bluff completed the last domino in Missouri men’s basketball’s mid-major homestand. When you’re the worst team ranked by KenPom, a bad game must be the norm. The Tigers came into the Friday afternoon game as a 38-point favorite and walked out just under that line with a 97-61 win against the Golden Lions. After a closer-than-expected 78-67 win over Evansville Tuesday night, Mizzou had to right some wrongs before a loaded December slate that includes four teams currently ranked in the AP Top 25. The changes started even before tipoff against the Golden Lions when Mark Mitchell was announced in the starting lineup in place of Kennard Davis Jr. Mitchell hadn’t started since suffering a concussion in the opening minute against SIUE on Nov. 9. The fifth-year forward injected life into the offense with 14 points, three rebounds and three assists on 6-for-8 shooting. All of his shots came from inside the arc, an area where the Tigers saw great success. Mizzou had a dominant performance inside the arc with 50 points in the paint and shot 74.6% on two-point attempts. The interior presence also came with trips to the free-throw line. The Tigers went 24-for-27 from the charity stripe as a team. Bryson Tiller contributed nine makes on 10 attempts in what was one of his most dominant performances of the season. The Kansas transfer finished the game with 22 points on 6-for-10 shooting to go with six rebounds and four blocks. Tiller only missed one shot inside the arc. Paint success once again came at the expense of another off-night from three-point range. Jason Crowe Jr. made all three of Mizzou’s triples in a 16.7% outside shooting night as a team, and it nearly replicated that performance against the Golden Lions. The Tigers went 5-for-20 from beyond the arc after beginning the first half shooting 3-for-4 from deep. Mizzou still adopted the big brother role to UAPB from the tip by securing six points off three turnovers less than two minutes into the game. It finished the game with 23 points off 18 turnovers. Toni Bryant and Trent Pierce set the tone on multiple defensive possessions. Bryant finished the night with seven blocks and could consistently be heard throughout Mizzou Arena with his active communication. The freshman also contributed 14 points, eight rebounds and four assists. Pierce continues to struggle offensively, but he’s playable because of his defensive impact. He ended the night with four steals and a block despite only scoring two points on three shots. The Tigers still have plenty to clean up ahead of what may be their biggest test of the season to this point. They host Pittsburgh at 6 p.m. Tuesday. The Panthers are currently 8-0 and ranked 35th in KenPom.

top.description: PITTSBURGH, PENNSYLVANIA - NOVEMBER 27: T.J. (Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Denver Broncos were blown out by the Pittsburgh Steelers on Black Friday, which has some big impacts on the AFC Playoff Picture. With this loss, the Broncos’ odds of winning the number one seed in the AFC have taken a big hit, and it also keeps the Chiefs within striking range for the AFC West. The Broncos still do have a favorable schedule upcoming and play the Bills, but no Broncos fan is thinking one seed after a loss like this. With the Chiefs’ loss on Thanksgiving Night, the Broncos still lead the AFC West but both teams are tied at 8-3. As for the Steelers, their wild week continues. It looks like they imploded. Aaron Rodgers was released, McCarthy was embarrassed on National Television, and the locker room appeared to be in disarray. Well, that all changed on Friday when they came out and absolutely dominated the Broncos at home, improved to 7-4, and kept their playoff hopes very alive. They move up to the 6th seed right now, but that could change after the weekend finishes. Looking ahead to the rest of the games this weekend, the Bengals play the Saints, the Jaguars play the Titans, and the Browns play on Sunday Night vs. the Raiders. Meanwhile, the Patriots, Texans, Raiders, and Ravens will look to get back on track and keep their postseason hopes alive. top.title: Winners, Losers from Pittsburgh Steelers’ Statement 27-5 Win Over Denver Broncos on Black Friday
top.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Aaron Rodgers made himself and head coach Mike McCarthy the story of the National Football League ahead of Thanksgiving, overshadowing an important Denver Broncos vs. Pittsburgh Steelers game on Black Friday that had major playoff implications. What we saw today probably shows why everyone is better off now that Rodgers will fade away into a darkness retreat where we never hear from him again. Let’s dive into the winners and losers from the Broncos vs Steelers matchup on Black Friday, with Pittsburgh making a massive statement with a 22-point win. Winner: Mike McCarthy, Pittsburgh Steelers Head Coach Nov 22, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy on the sidelines against the Philadelphia Eagles at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images An overwhelming majority of the reactions league-wide to what Rodgers said about Mike McCarthy defended the kind of person McCarthy was. It was noticeable that many of the accusations made against the Steelers head coach weren’t rebuffed. After having his play-calling, game preparation and work ethic all called out on a national stage, McCarthy desperately needed to respond on the field. He did just that. Against a top-10 defense, the Steelers offense backed up its head coach and play-caller where it counts. In the first half alone, the Steelers offense had nearly as many total yards (132) as it had in the first half of its last two games combined (139) with Rodgers. Pittsburgh’s defense also seemed quite motivated to come through for its head coach, scoring two touchdowns on its own with two sacks and zero red-zone trips allowed to Denver in the first half. Clearly, the entire Steelers locker room is happy to keep playing and winning for McCarthy. Meanwhile… Loser: Aaron Rodgers Nov 22, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers (8) leaves the field after the game at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Aaron Rodgers is going to be a first-ballot Hall of Famer and rightfully remembered years from now as one of the most gifted quarterbacks in NFL history. He should also be known moving forward for causing one of, if not the most, disastrous ends to a legendary playing career in the history of pro sports. When you have your head coach last year (Mike Tomlin), former teammates (Greg Jennings, T.J. Lang and James Jones) along with your well-respected peers (Tom Brady) all rip you for how you handled your exit and trying to sabotage McCarthy’s coaching career, that speaks volumes about your reputation. Fittingly, it was made even worse for Rodgers by the fact that the Steelers responded to Rodgers’ exit by immediately putting up 14 points against Denver. Rodgers did serious damage to his reputation this week. Winner: T.J. Watt and Nick Herbig, EDGE, Pittsburgh Steelers Nov 27, 2026; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers line

top.title: Houston Texans welcome back Woody Marks and Marvin Harrison Jr. as offense gets a boost Sunday
top.description: Houston Texans running back Woody Marks (4) runs the ball against Cleveland Browns cornerback Denzel Ward (21) during the first half of an NFL football game in Cleveland, Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. (Brett Coomer/Houston Chronicle) Houston Texans running back Woody Marks and wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. will return Sunday against the Baltimore Ravens. Marks missed last week's win over the Indianapolis Colts with a concussion, while Harrison missed the past two games with a hamstring injury. "I just want to help the team win games," Harrison said. "At the end of the day, that's why every person, every player is here on this team." Harrison has six catches in three games since the Texans acquired him after their Week 5 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars to bolster their receiving corps. He hasn't been an immediate difference-maker for Houston, but he also wasn't expected to quickly take on a heavy workload as he learned the Texans' system. Harrison played fewer than 21% of the team's snaps in each of his first two games before his share jumped to 45% against the Los Angeles Chargers in his third game. Harrison said he continued learning the playbook while recovering from his injury and feels very good about his understanding of it. "Getting him back right now is a perfect time to get him rolling," Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud said. "He's been running great routes. I think everybody's been seeing that. Have to find ways to get him to rock. I think he's doing a great job creating separation and we'll continue to do that for us." Marks' return will mark the first time in nearly two months that Houston's top two running backs will enter a game healthy. David Montgomery returned from an injury of his own last week against the Colts. Montgomery, who had struggled for most of the season outside of a standout Week 1, rushed for more than 100 yards in the win. In the five games before missing the Colts game with an injury, Marks averaged more than 60 yards per game. How the Texans will split their snaps is unclear, but offensive coordinator Nick Caley said earlier in the week that having both players back is good for the team. "When we run the ball, everybody just needs to handle their assignment the right way," coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday. "We'll get a ton of different looks this week from the Ravens. We just have to make sure we're communicating the right way." While those two key pieces will be back Sunday, Houston's offense won't be fully healthy. Wide receiver Kayshon Boutte is out with a hip injury, while left guard Keylan Rutledge also will be unavailable with neck and shoulder injuries. Fellow rookie Febechi Nwaiwu will fill in for Rutledge at left guard for his second career start. Nwaiwu started for Rutledge two weeks ago against the Cleveland Browns and played well. top.title: Max Melton calls out Arizona Cardinals as defense searches for answers
top.description: Shortly before the Arizona Cardinals ’ final practice of the week on Friday, Nov. 27, cornerback Max Melton took to social media to voice his latest round of frustration. “I do something to somebody?” wrote Melton, who played zero defensive snaps last week for the first time in his career. Later, inside the Cardinals locker room, Melton explained the source of his discontent. “I don't know what I did to get my time taken away,” Melton said. “I feel like I was having a really good season. That's pretty much it. I asked. I'm yet to get a clear answer. (Expletive) That was really it. I thought I was having a good season. Shooting 1000%? No way. But 90s? Yeah.” On the season, Melton has allowed 19 catches for 201 yards and two touchdowns on 33 targets, per Pro Football Focus. His passer rating when targeted is 95.6 — better than Denzel Burke, but trailing behind Kei’Tel Clark. That number had also ticked up in recent weeks. To start the season, Melton had four pass breakups in five games, performing at the highest level of any Cardinals cornerback. But over the past month, he was culpable for a handful of big plays as his snap share gradually decreased, culminating in last week’s full-time move to the bench. Melton, though, was not alone with his occasional miscues. In the final few games under Nick Rallis, few Cardinals defensive players delivered standout performances. "I haven't got a clear answer to what I've done to get removed," Melton said. "What I have to do to get back out there? I'm just sticking to a normal routine, still making plays in practice, still paying attention in meetings, still doing everything I think is right. But I don't know. I'm just kind of lost and frustrated." Melton said that he had been hoping his role would expand after the Cardinals fired Rallis this week, installing Teryl Austin as their interim defensive coordinator. That, however, has not happened, as the Cardinals seemingly plan to once again deploy Burke and Clark as their starting outside cornerbacks. “It's still early,” Melton said. “We've only been out here a couple days. So immediate change, maybe not. But I don't know. I'm just confused. I thought I was having a good season. It's frustrating.” Despite his frustration, Melton was able to impress on special teams last week, taking three kick returns for 103 yards. He also downed a punt inside the five-yard line. “I love special teams,” Melton said. “I'm from (Rutgers coach) Greg Schiano. Anything to help the team. I still love the guys and stuff like that. Still support and do whatever I can so we can win. But I love special teams. You see them out returning. I always wanted to do that.” Still, it’s hardly the role either Melton or the Cardinals envisioned when he was selected 43rd overall in the 2024 draft. But that level of squandered capital has been a common theme for the Cardinals. top.title: Comeback, Commence: Panthers Score in Final Minute, Stun Capitals
top.description: The Florida Panthers trailed the host Capitals by a goal with less than 5 minutes remaining to play on Friday. Then, the comeback commenced. Eetu Luostarinen tied the score off a pass from Brad Marchand before Matthew Tkachuk ’s shot was knocked in by Sam Bennett with 23.2 seconds left leading the Panthers to a 3-2 win. With the win, the Panthers slid into second place in the Atlantic Division what with Tampa Bay getting blown out at home to the Senators. The Panthers will fly home to face the Lightning in Sunrise on Saturday night. Cole Hutson became the fastest defenseman in Capitals history to hit 10 goals in the first period against the Panthers on Friday afternoon. In the third, Hutson got to 11. top.title: Chelsea in a 'difficult moment' admits Alonso
top.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso reacts after the 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest (Darren Staples) Xabi Alonso admitted Chelsea are in a "difficult moment" as the beleaguered boss urged his struggling side to stick together after their dismal 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest on Friday. Alonso's side crashed to a third successive Premier League loss to leave them languishing in eighth place. The Blues have lost four of their last five league matches, piling pressure on Alonso just months into his reign at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea fell behind to Igor Jesus's early opener before Morgan Gibbs-White doubled Forest's lead with a second half penalty. Emmanuel Emegha reduced the deficit but Gibbs-White struck again to make Emega's late second nothing more than a footnote on another dispiriting evening for Alonso. "It's a difficult moment for everyone. It's disappointing again to lose again but we need to keep trying to find solutions, we can't stop," Alonso said. "We are low in confidence, the team is struggling to hold a result. After getting to 2-1 we have conceded and go to 3-1. "Everything is not going our way, we are responsible for that and we are responsible to find solutions." Chelsea have already conceded 23 goals in 12 league matches and their porous defence was not helped by Alonso's curious decision to use Ecuador midfielder Moises Caicedo in a back-three. Alonso also selected Wesley Fofana after the centre-back was forced to apologise for joking in a YouTube interview about missing a penalty during Chelsea's League Cup defeat against Liverpool this season. The hapless Fofana was booed by angry Chelsea fans at the City Ground and conceded a penalty with his careless foul on former Blues striker Liam Delap. "We need to support everyone. Everyone that is in the team we need to support," Alonso said of Fofana. "We know we have to go through difficult moments. We don't take apart anyone and we want to help." Asked to assess Chelsea's dismal run, Alonso suggested the only cure was hard work on the training ground. "We can do better for sure. At this level you need to hold results and that is why we are losing in the last games," he said after Chelsea's sixth league defeat his term. "That is the only way I understand football. When things are not going well, try to work and find solutions. It can happen that we turn it around and it goes our way." Chelsea's sixth league defeat under Alonso will spark pointed questions about the former Real Madrid and Bayer Leverkusen boss. Although Alonso led Leverkusen to an historic Bundesliga title in 2024, he lasted just seven months before being sacked by Real. The former Liverpool midfielder desperately needs a win against bottom of the table Crystal Palace on Wednesday to avoid the sack talk growing even louder. "Everyone needs to stick together and go through this moment. We have to deal with it," he said. smg/bsp

top.description: Aaron Rodgers isn’t ready to let his ugly divorce from the Pittsburgh Steelers go quietly. On Friday, the former Steelers quarterback offered another public defense of his controversial decision to air his grievances with head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show . Just one day after Tom Brady weighed in on the importance of protecting the sanctity of an NFL locker room, Rodgers offered a decidedly different perspective. This time, he delivered his message through legendary NFL broadcaster Al Michaels. They took this public. Never heard from the head coach. Then they leaked at 11 p.m. They also barred me from the facility. That’s why I went to McAfee.” Rodgers’ comments come after he made several stunning allegations about McCarthy , including claims that the coach slept during meetings and mistakenly referred to the Steelers as the Packers during halftime of Sunday’s game. Aaron Rodgers and Tom Brady Clearly See Things Differently During Thursday’s Eagles-Cowboys broadcast, Brady criticized Rodgers for making private matters public . The seven-time Super Bowl champion emphasized that individual interests should never supersede what a team is trying to accomplish. Brady wasn’t alone in his criticism, as several former NFL players expressed similar concerns during Thanksgiving broadcasts. Rodgers did not specifically mention Brady in his text to Michaels, but his choice of words certainly appeared to address the growing criticism. Meanwhile, the Steelers were dominating the Broncos when Michaels shared Rodgers’ message. For McCarthy, winning football games may be the most effective response of all.

top.description: LAFC fight for MLS Cup Playoffs survival vs. St. Louis CITY By Ari Liljenwall With their season on the line, LAFC must turn the tide in Game 2 of their Western Conference Round One Best-of-3 Series against St. Louis CITY SC . After suffering a 3-2 defeat at Energizer Park in Game 1, the Black & Gold return home to BMO Stadium on Saturday (8:30 pm ET | Apple TV ) needing a victory to force a decisive Game 3 in St. Louis on Dec. 2. Despite the series-opening setback, interim head coach Xavi Tamarit was encouraged by his team's response in recent days. “The week has been very good, a very good week of training," Tamarit told reporters Friday. “I feel the players [have] the confidence that we can do it, so that gives me a lot of confidence. “We know they are a very good team," he added. "They have a lot of weapons, but we do also. We feel that we didn't have an amazing game the other day, and we were very close to drawing at the end when, in the last 30 minutes, we started to play better.” Backs against the wall While LAFC never found an equalizer in Game 1, they showed resilience in the second half. The Gabon international also acknowledged the team's struggles to maintain their discipline when playing from behind. “When we concede one goal, we want to forget everything,” added Bouanga. Tamarit believes his players are eager to make amends for their Game 1 defeat. “I think the game is going to be different than the other day. top.title: How the opening night of Nations Championship finals weekend fell flat
top.description: It had been billed as a three-day Super Bowl of rugby but the grand opening of the Nations Championship finals weekend fell short of such lofty comparisons. Sparsely attended, bitterly cold, a few television technical gremlins – one always feared this Friday night would be a tough sell and so it proved. Not many more than 30,000 spectators made it in to watch Ireland complete a November clean sweep with victory over Australia, and far fewer for Italy’s narrow win over Fiji that preceded it. Ireland overcame Australia at a sparsely-attended Twickenham (AP) With those results came a 2-0 lead for the north in the race for the “Hemisphere Shield”, though that the organisers spent much of the night clarifying that these were not placing play-offs said plenty about a competition still yet to truly cut through. Colossal contests await over the weekend as the southern hemisphere powers seek revenge on their northern foes, but neither England vs New Zealand nor the grand final between France and South Africa is expected to draw a full house. There was an admirable effort at razzmatazz wrapped around the logistical challenges that a double-header poses – but this first of three consecutive rugby-laden days suggested an imperfect idea that requires some refinement. nigeria.title: A Weekend For Proof
nigeria.description: INEC tests its systems on Saturday. Opposition leaders face their own test on Monday. Campaign violence makes both exercises more consequential. By Tuesday, Nigerians should have fresh evidence about two institutions seeking their confidence. INEC will have conducted its nationwide mock accreditation and result-upload exercise. Opposition parties will have had their scheduled opportunity to formalise cooperation in Abuja. The first must demonstrate operational readiness. The second must demonstrate an ability to act together. Both approach those tests amid a worsening concern: whether citizens can participate in the campaign safely. Wednesday’s attack on Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) supporters in Benin City, Edo State, confirmed by the police, followed Monday’s deadly violence in Delta. Edo police reported one person injured and ordered an investigation. The attackers’ political affiliations and any sponsors have not been established. That development changes the context of the coming days. Electoral preparation now requires visible progress on protection, accountability and public confidence alongside equipment and political agreements. Saturday: Let The Test Produce Evidence INEC’s mock exercise is scheduled for November 28, from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Nigerian time, in 17,676 selected polling units. It will test accreditation, election devices, and the uploading and viewing of simulated results. Registered voters in the selected units are expected to participate. The most useful outcome would be a public account of performance. How many locations opened on time? How many participants were successfully accredited? Where did devices fail? How long did uploads take? How were exceptions resolved? A rehearsal can reveal problems that announcements cannot. Finding a fault early allows INEC to correct it. Explaining that correction gives citizens a reason to have greater confidence. The exercise also has practical support from state governments. Lagos has cancelled Saturday’s sanitation exercise, while Anambra has postponed its own, to avoid obstructing participation. Those decisions remove an immediate obstacle. The remaining test concerns delivery at the selected polling units. Monday: What Will Opposition Unity Require? Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, Seyi Makinde and other opposition leaders are expected at the November 30 summit. Their attendance and any signed commitments remain forthcoming. The APC says it is untroubled by the proposed gathering. The parties’ task is to define cooperation precisely. Joint election monitoring could be valuable. So could common procedures for documenting intimidation, sharing verified information and coordinating legal responses. Presidential cooperation presents more difficult choices. Supporters need to know whether their parties intend to campaign separately, endorse an existing candidate or pursue another lawful arrangement. A declaration of unity leaves those questions open unless it specifies obligations.

nigeria.title: Two Nigerians arrested over romance scam in Thailand
nigeria.description: Two Nigerian men have been arrested in Thailand over their alleged links to an international romance scam network targeting victims across Southeast Asia. The suspects, aged 41 and 30, were arrested on November 18 at a condominium in Ban Mai, Pak Kret district, Nonthaburi, following an investigation by Thailand’s Immigration Division 3 and Provincial Police Region 1. According to local media outlet, The Thaiger, undercover police officers disguised themselves as food delivery workers to gain access to the suspects’ apartment. With the help of security guards, the officers approached the condominium and pretended to have a parcel for delivery. When one of the men opened the door, they identified themselves as police officers and moved in to arrest both suspects. A search of the apartment reportedly led to the recovery of laptops and mobile phones containing messages linked to fake online identities posing as US military personnel. Investigators suspect the identities were used to establish romantic relationships with potential victims as part of an international scam operation. Police also reportedly found social media accounts allegedly created to deceive Thai residents. The arrests followed an earlier investigation on November 12, when police detained another Nigerian man, aged 37, at Owl Market in Nonthaburi over suspected links to the same network. Investigators later searched a condominium in Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi, where suspected members of the group had reportedly stayed. However, the men had left before the search. Police subsequently traced the two suspects to another condominium in the Muang Thong Thani area, where they were believed to have stayed for two to three days before their arrest. The Thaiger reported that both men confessed during questioning. However, the charges publicly reported against them are immigration-related offences, including illegal entry and unauthorised residence. One of the suspects, aged 41, had reportedly overstayed his permitted stay in Thailand by 411 days. Authorities revoked their permission to remain in the country and transferred them to Pak Kret Police Station for further legal proceedings ahead of deportation. The investigation into the suspected romance scam network is ongoing. Thai police have not disclosed the identities of the alleged victims, the amount of money involved or the specific roles the two men allegedly played in the operation. nigeria.title: Adesua Etomi celebrates negative cancer test
nigeria.description: Nollywood actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has celebrated testing negative for cancer after months of medical procedures, hospital visits and uncertainty over her health. The actress announced the development on Friday in an Instagram video, expressing gratitude to God following the latest result from her medical tests. “The doctor just called me back with the result from the lab, no cancer… God is good,” she said. The video showed some of the medical procedures she underwent, while other pictures revealed bruises on her body and redness beneath one of her eyes. Etomi-Wellington also shared a video of friends and well-wishers celebrating the result with her. Reflecting on her experience, the actress described 2026 as one of the most difficult periods of her life, explaining that her reduced public appearances were linked to her health struggles. “2026 really tried it. I know I’ve been quieter than usual this year (and that’s saying something), but behind the silence were some of the most difficult months of my life,” she wrote. She disclosed that the ordeal involved several medical procedures, scans, injections and hospital visits, adding that she received treatment from medical teams in Nigeria and the United States. “This year threw everything at me, but by the grace of God, I am NOT EASILY BROKEN,” she added. The actress also expressed appreciation to her husband, singer and politician Bankole Wellington, popularly known as Banky W, their children, friends and family members for supporting her throughout the difficult period. “To my friends and family who prayed for me, stood in the gap and held me through some of my darkest days, I will never take your love for granted,” she wrote. The health update comes two days after the couple released a gospel song, On My Way , on November 25 to celebrate their ninth wedding anniversary. The track, credited to Etomi-Wellington, who performs under the musical name Susu, and Banky W, is the lead single from their forthcoming joint album, Not Easily Broken , expected in 2027. The actress described the song as “the soundtrack to our testimony and thanksgiving”, linking its message to their personal experiences. The couple have previously spoken about their health challenges. In May 2024, Banky W disclosed that he had undergone his fourth surgery for cancer after earlier procedures to remove cancerous tumours. Etomi-Wellington also revealed in March 2025 that she battled hyperemesis gravidarum, a severe form of pregnancy sickness, during her second pregnancy. nigeria.title: UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax
nigeria.description: The United Kingdom government has outlined two conditions under which travellers can bring goods into the country without paying customs duty or tax, warning that items outside the permitted categories or allowance limits could attract charges. According to the UK government’s customs guidelines, travellers can bring goods into the country tax-free under two conditions. First condition is personal use. Goods must be intended for the traveller’s own use rather than for commercial purposes or resale. Second condition is gifts. Travellers can also bring goods intended as presents for other people without paying customs duty, provided they remain within the applicable personal allowance. The rules apply to foreign visitors and British residents returning from overseas, regardless of whether the items were purchased from regular shops or duty-free outlets at airports. However, the exemptions are subject to personal allowance limits, which determine the quantity and value of goods travellers can bring into the country without incurring additional charges. The applicable allowance depends on where a traveller is arriving from and whether the destination is Great Britain, comprising England, Scotland and Wales, or Northern Ireland. The government also warned that goods intended for business or resale do not qualify for personal allowances. Such items must be declared to customs regardless of their value or quantity. Travellers are also required to declare goods that exceed their personal allowances or fall under banned and restricted categories before crossing the border. Declarations can be made online up to five days, or 120 hours, before arrival in the UK. The authorities warned that failure to comply with customs regulations could result in the seizure of goods and, in some cases, the vehicle used to transport them. Offenders may also face financial penalties or prosecution. The post UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: mRNA Ebola vaccine trial launched in Uganda
nigeria.description: Trials of an experimental Ebola vaccine launched in Uganda on Friday, while a global NGO said it had bought 1.5 million doses of another candidate, as the race heats up to contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. There are currently no vaccines or treatments for the less common Bundibugyo strain of Ebola behind the outbreak in DRC, which has caused more than 5,700 confirmed deaths out of more than 11,000 cases since being declared in May, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). Two experimental vaccines are due to start testing on Monday in the outbreak’s epicentre in eastern DRC, the WHO said, focusing on contacts of cases and people deemed at high risk of infection. But neighbouring Uganda announced it had also launched a trial of one of the vaccines, developed by the US-based Moderna group using the mRNA technology made famous during the Covid pandemic. The Uganda Virus Research Institute described it as “Africa’s first mRNA Phase I clinical trial”, conducted in collaboration with Moderna. It will test 224 healthy volunteers aged between one and 65 to measure its safety and immunity potential. The other potential vaccine is the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine developed by India’s Serum Institute and the University of Oxford — which will also begin testing in DRC on Monday. But Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, which brings together government and private donors to help developing countries acquire jabs at affordable prices, is not waiting around. After the Covid-19 pandemic, the alliance set up a new $50 million First Response Fund — under a so-called “No Regrets” approach — to allow it to buy up doses in advance even before they have been fully tested. – Deployment – Gavi signed a purchase commitment this week with the Serum Institute for 1.5 million doses of the ChAdOx1, and plans to have “hundreds of thousands” ready to deploy should the trials prove successful and they are approved by the WHO and DRC government. “We’re investing in it, hoping that the signals will be positive, and if that is the case, we’ll have gained months and months on the deployment,” Emanuele Capobianco, Gavi’s director of global health security, told AFP. He said he hoped for trials to conclude “within the first half of 2027” and even “within the first quarter” in a more optimistic scenario. Gavi also has a stockpile of 500,000 doses of an existing vaccine, Ervebo, used against the Zaire strain of Ebola, which began testing last month to see if it is also effective against Bundibugyo. Despite a long and porous border with eastern DRC, Uganda has successfully contained the virus after receiving some imported cases earlier this year. It was declared Ebola-free in August after registering 20 cases, including two deaths. The post mRNA Ebola vaccine trial launched in Uganda appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: Nigeria set to bid to host maiden U-17 WAFCON
nigeria.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Nigeria is preparing to bid to host the maiden edition of the Under-17 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), as the country seeks to attract more international sporting competitions and strengthen its sports economy. The Director-General of the National Sports Commission (NSC), Bukola Olopade, disclosed this in a video shared on his X handle on Friday, saying Nigeria had already communicated its interest to the Confederation of African Football (CAF). According to Olopade, the country expressed its desire to host the competition during CAF’s General Assembly held in Abuja last weekend. “We have said to CAF that we are desirous of hosting the first Under-17 women’s championship,” he said. He explained that the move forms part of Nigeria’s ambition to move away from what he described as a consuming sports economy towards a productive one, where hosting international events would generate economic benefits for the country. “We don’t want to be a consuming sports economy; rather, we want to be a productive sports economy. We want to attract more international events where the economic impacts will be felt by the people,” Olopade added. CAF’s Executive Committee approved the introduction of the U-17 WAFCON on November 21, with the inaugural tournament scheduled to take place between March and April 2028. Qualifying matches are expected to begin in April 2027. Nigeria’s interest in hosting the competition comes amid discussions about the country’s readiness to stage major international football events. Earlier this week, FIFA President Gianni Infantino said Nigeria was not yet ready to host the men’s FIFA World Cup, although he acknowledged the country’s resources, passion and willingness to stage the competition. Infantino, however, suggested that Nigeria could demonstrate its organisational capacity by hosting smaller international football tournaments before taking on events of greater magnitude. The proposed U-17 WAFCON could therefore provide Nigeria with an opportunity to showcase its capacity to organise a continental football competition. nigeria.description: Hackers have breached Cloud One, the United States Air Force’s flagship cloud computing platform, potentially exposing sensitive military, personnel and logistics data. Three people familiar with the matter told Reuters that the intrusion was discovered within the past month during efforts to upgrade the system, triggering disruptions across the platform. However, the identity of the hackers, the full extent of the breach and whether any data was stolen remain unknown. In a statement to Reuters, the US Air Force declined to discuss the security status of specific networks and systems. It said: “We continuously take prudent measures to protect Department (of the Air Force) information, systems and mission capabilities.” A major military computing platform Launched in 2017, Cloud One was designed as a centralised platform for the Air Force’s information technology needs, bringing together services provided by four major technology companies: Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle and Alphabet. The platform supports dozens of applications, including systems managing personnel records, salaries, logistics and military equipment maintenance. Among the applications hosted on Cloud One are the Air Force’s Cloud-Based Command and Control system, which consolidates air defence radar and other data feeds across North America, and the Theatre Integrated Combat Munitions System, which tracks bombs and missiles at more than 200 US Air Force locations worldwide. Cloud One is regarded as one of the US military’s largest cloud computing platforms, according to two sources familiar with the matter. “A breach here is a big deal,” one of the sources told Reuters. Investigators have reportedly involved US Cyber Command, the military’s cyber warfare arm, to assess the damage. Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) served as the platform’s prime contractor until 2025, when Leidos took over the contract. SAIC did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment, while Leidos referred questions to the Air Force. Breach disrupts military operations The intrusion has reportedly triggered several disruptions across the platform. Two sources and another person familiar with the matter said plans to migrate additional back-office applications to Cloud One, a longstanding military priority, had been suspended. Updates to applications already running on the platform were also blocked, preventing Air Force personnel from installing fixes, even as new software vulnerabilities were being disclosed across the technology industry. Another source said some users had their administrator privileges revoked. One of the sources said the hackers exploited a software vulnerability to gain access to the platform’s control plane, which manages and oversees the underlying cloud infrastructure. nigeria.title: France slips into ‘technical recession’ after GDP revision
nigeria.description: France’s economy has slipped into a technical recession after revised official figures showed that gross domestic product (GDP) contracted in the third quarter, extending the country’s economic decline. The National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) said on Friday that the eurozone’s second-largest economy shrank by 0.2 per cent in the third quarter, revising its initial estimate of a 0.1 per cent contraction. The agency also revised second-quarter growth downwards to 0.02 per cent from zero per cent previously, although the figure was rounded to zero in the headline data. The revisions mean France’s economy has recorded consecutive quarterly contractions since the end of last year, meeting the conventional definition of a technical recession, which is two successive quarters of negative economic growth. The latest figures pose additional challenges for the government as it struggles to rein in the country’s budget deficit, with its target of 0.5 per cent economic growth this year now appearing increasingly difficult to achieve. The minority government is also facing difficulties securing parliamentary approval for its 2027 budget, which seeks to reduce the fiscal deficit from 5.4 per cent of GDP this year to five per cent next year. The budget debate comes five months before France’s presidential election, amid deep divisions in parliament. Reacting to the figures, Finance Minister Roland Lescure called for the speedy adoption of the budget, insisting that the five per cent deficit target was non-negotiable. “We must adopt a budget as soon as possible with a non-negotiable deficit target of 5%. It is imperative that we restore visibility for economic stakeholders,” he said. A breakdown of the third-quarter GDP figures by INSEE showed that weak domestic demand contributed to the contraction. Consumer spending rose by 0.3 per cent, but this was offset by a 0.8 per cent decline in business investment. The rebuilding of business inventories contributed 0.3 percentage points to GDP growth, following a 0.7 percentage-point reduction in the previous quarter. Foreign trade also weighed heavily on economic performance, subtracting 0.6 percentage points from output as exports fell by 1.6 per cent while imports increased by 0.1 per cent. Despite the contraction, the Bank of France said earlier in November that the economy was expected to record moderate growth in the fourth quarter. He said the test would appear in the app on Nov. 27 and work like the bank’s existing tests for other instruments. VTB handles the buying, storage and record-keeping itself on Russian infrastructure. The bank received its digital depository and crypto exchange licenses on Oct. 6. “At the start, we will focus on buying and selling cryptocurrencies, and then we will introduce additional services as regulation develops,” Yatskov said. Eight questions before the first trade The launch came quickly after the regulator moved. On Nov. 26, the Bank of Russia approved the first basic standards for brokers and crypto exchange offices, setting the rules for the test. Every investor has to take it, qualified or not, and it is free. Buyers must answer at least seven of eight questions correctly. The standard lays out eight topic blocks, from regulation, technical basics and information security to stablecoins, low-liquidity coins, address labeling and blocked transactions, and volatility, with one question drawn at random from each. Investors who fail can try once more the same day, with different questions. Brokers are barred from sharing the correct answers with clients or telling them which questions they missed. A passing result stays valid for one year from the test date or the latest trade, whichever comes later. The test was the missing piece for Russian banks. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders A New York judge has ordered the founders of NovaTech, a cryptocurrency investment scheme that targeted Haitian communities, to pay more than $1.37 billion, closing out the state’s case against a couple who fled the country rather than answer it. Justice Anar Rathod Patel of the New York County Supreme Court signed the order on Nov. 24. It holds Cynthia and Eddy Petion and their companies NovaTech Ltd, NovaTech Advisors and NovaPay jointly liable for $1,367,023,585 in disgorgement and interest. New York Attorney General Letitia James announced the win on Wednesday. “Today’s historic judgment finally delivers some semblance of justice for the thousands of New Yorkers who were targeted by this merciless scam,” James said. “NovaTech cruelly targeted immigrant families through faith and community groups with the promise of a better life while robbing them of their life savings.” Where the $1.37 billion figure comes from The award matches what the attorney general’s office asked for in October . The figure starts with the cryptocurrency investors sent to NovaTech’s wallet at payment processor CoinPayments, which totaled about $1.16 billion from August 2019 through May 2023, according to an affirmation filed by the state. Prosecutors subtracted the roughly $26 million NovaTech actually moved to its trading platform, leaving $1.13 billion in principal. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin’s Bear Market Ended in June Galaxy has withdrawn its October call that bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, saying the technical signal behind it failed after seven straight weeks of losses and that the bear market is “very likely not over.” Alex Thorn, Galaxy’s head of firmwide research, laid out the reversal in a report published Wednesday and sent to clients a day earlier. “We withdraw our call that the bear market ended in June,” the report said. “The signal it rested on has failed.” The firm’s Oct. 26 note had argued that bitcoin had entered an accumulation phase. Galaxy said at the time that a weekly close back below the 50-week moving average that was not regained within a month would invalidate its technical case. That is what happened. Bitcoin closed the week ended Nov. 8 at $74,968, 0.7% below the 50-week average, after seven weekly closes above it. It then closed the week ended Nov. 15 below the 200-week average, which Galaxy has described as the floor of past bear markets. Galaxy points to $58,525 The week ended Nov. 22 closed at $61,104, 17.9% below the 50-week average and 10.4% below the 200-week average of $68,159. Bitcoin traded below its July 1 intraday low on Nov. 20 and reached $55,100 on Nov. 21, but the June 30 closing low of $58,525 held on a daily basis through Nov. 22. Galaxy now treats that level as the line to watch. A daily close below $58,525 would be “the start of a move to a materially lower low,” the report said, and the firm would not treat such a close as a buying signal by itself. History is not kind to breaks like that. In the seven prior bear market cases where bitcoin closed below a low that had stood for at least 60 days, the eventual low was at least 17% lower, with a median of 52%. Applied to the June low, that works out to about $48,500 and $28,200. entertainment.description: Young man with a hard hat holding a red for sale sign outside a building by Pavel Danilyuk for Pexels . My parents’ generation mostly bought land the way their parents did. Someone in the family knew someone in the village. An uncle walked the boundaries. The community remembered who owned what, and if anything went wrong, you had a face to go back to. However, my generation buys land on Instagram. I do not say that to mock anyone. I sell land for a living. When I started in real estate sales in 2023, two years after finishing a Mathematics degree at the University of Ibadan, I assumed buyers would care most about price and location. They do care. But what I hear most often is fear, dressed up as questions. Can I trust you? Is this land real? What happens if I miss a payment? After I pay, will someone come and ask me for more money? A prospective buyer once asked me, before anything else, whether community or family payments would follow after she paid for her plot. She was not asking about the land. She was asking whether the price I quoted was the real price. She had good reason to ask. Lagos State’s Property Protection Law of 2016 made it an offence to demand levies for construction on someone else’s property. Yet the same law still allows a land-owning family, with the family head’s authority, to collect a customary fee for possession, the payment many people know as a “foundation levy”. So the honest answer to her question is not a simple yes or no. It depends on the land, the family, and what has been written down. Most first-time buyers have never been told any of this. That is the gap I keep coming back to. Nobody taught us how to buy land. We learned how to save. Some of us learned how to invest in stocks, crypto or a side business. But land, the asset our parents spoke about with the most respect, has no manual. The people who used to stand in for the manual–the uncle, the community, the family lawyer everyone trusted–are often not part of how we buy anymore. So we improvise. A prospect once told me she had gone through my Instagram page carefully before she agreed to speak with me. She was checking whether I was consistent, whether my posts matched what I said on the phone, whether I had been around long enough to be real. I was flattered. Then I was worried. At the fourth edition of Africa Credit Expo (ACE) 202 6, stakeholders across financial services, technology, policy, investment and entrepreneurship examined the role of reliable credit information, financial inclusion and collaboration in expanding access to capital. Powered by CreditRegistry and supported by Afreximbank , the Expo was held on Friday, 13 November 2026, at the J. F. Ade Ajayi Main Auditorium, University of Lagos. Themed “Reimagining Africa’s Credit Economy: Unlocking Capital, Trust and Opportunity,” the event provided a platform for conversations on the systems, innovations and partnerships shaping the future of credit across the continent. Building Trust and Expanding Access to Capital Discussions at the Expo explored the role of credible credit information in building trust between lenders and borrowers. Reliable data enables financial institutions to assess risk more effectively and make informed lending decisions, while individuals and businesses with established credit histories are better positioned to demonstrate their credit worthiness. The conversations also considered the financing constraints facing micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). Despite their contribution to employment and economic activity, many small businesses continue to encounter barriers to affordable financing. Improving access to relevant financial products and strengthening credit information systems remain important to addressing these gaps. Technology, Financial Inclusion and the Next Generation Digital innovation and data intelligence featured prominently in discussions about the future of credit. Alternative credit assessment approaches have the potential to broaden access for individuals and businesses with limited formal credit histories. However, the expansion of digital financial services must be accompanied by responsible lending practices, consumer protection and transparency. The Expo also placed attention on young people through student-focused sessions and discussions on financial literacy. These conversations connected access to credit with the need for individuals to understand financial management, borrowing and long-term wealth creation. This focus reflects the February 2026 memorandum of understanding between CreditRegistry and the University of Lagos, through its Entrepreneurship and Skills Development Centre (ESDC), to integrate the Africa Consumer Credit Academy (ACCA) curriculum into the Centre’s programmes. Over a screen career spanning nearly four decades, Pete Edochie became synonymous with authority,traditional wisdom, and unforgettable Igbo proverbs. Whether playing stern monarchs, principled elders, or complex patriarchs, he delivered every line with unmistakable gravitas. His extensive filmography includes standout appearances in classics and modern hits alike, such as Things Fall Apart (1987), Igodo (1999), Egg of Life (2003), Oracle (2003), Billionaires Club (2003), End of Money (2005), Lionheart (2018)—where he starred as Chief Ernest Obiagu alongside Genevieve Nnaji—Unroyal (2020), and Foreigner’s God (2022). sports.title: Henry Cejudo reflects on passing of Eddie Cha: ‘Master Cha, you will always be remembered’
sports.description: Henry Cejudo and Eddie Cha worked closely for years Henry Cejudo is going to miss Eddie Cha. On Wednesday, Cha, the famed striking coach at Fight Ready in Glendale, Ariz., died suddenly of unknown causes . During his career, Cha worked with some of the biggest names in MMA, but arguably his most successful student is former UFC flyweight and bantamweight champion Henry Cejudo. Speaking with MMA Fighting’s Mike Heck ahead of RAF 15, Cejudo reacted to the sudden passing of his longtime coach. “It hurts,” Cejudo said. “It’s sad. I don’t know if you guys remember when Kobe died, Kobe Bryant—obviously he wasn’t Kobe Bryant, known by the world, but the people that loved him, something just doesn’t sit right. … 53 years old. Great man, great husband, great coach, great friend, and it’s just too bad. He’s too young to leave. But we never know when it’s our turn. Life is life. It’s just unfortunate. It’s very sad. … “I know Eddie would want us to continue, keep pushing forward, and I’m going to honor Eddie this weekend with this victory.” Cha was a significant figure in Cejudo’s MMA career, shepherding the Olympic wrestling champion’s transition to MMA striking. Cejudo gave one example of just how much of an impact Cha had on him. “He brought a lot of the traditional Tae Kwon Do style of ‘Yes, sir. Yes, mister.’ Just respecting your elders type of thing,” Cejudo said. “And he would always—very kind in that sense, and he would give you the small little bow, whether you’re an elder, he would open the door for you, things like that. You could tell he comes from a really good tradition of how he was raised through martial arts. “I think the biggest thing with Eddie, he came up with the game plan when I beat Dominick Cruz. We started getting the feel—and you could hear it, too. You can see when I gave him a shoutout right after the fight. They gave me the post-fight mic with Joe Rogan, and I was just like, ‘Hey man, that was all Eddie Cha,’ and it was, because he was just smart. He was like, ‘Dominick moves his upper body a lot; he’s hard to hit up top, but Henry, look what he leaves behind: his legs.’ So we kicked the crap out of his legs. So that was something that I really started to do because of Eddie. “I think everybody has an impact in your life, and Eddie is definitely one of them. I’m just heartbroken, still. But I know what Eddie would want. He’s like, ‘Dude, keep moving forward.’ He was there when my sister died; he gave me great advice, and things like that. Guys were always there. Condolences to him and his family and everybody that loved him. Eddie Cha, Master Cha, you will always be remembered.” Cejudo competes in the main event of RAF 15 on Saturday, defending his lightweight crossover title against past MMA opponent Song Yadong.

sports.title: Mizzou Heads Into December on 6-Game Win Streak After UAPB Win
sports.description: Nov 27, 2026; Columbia, Missouri, USA; Missouri Tigers forward Bryson Tiller (15) shoots a layup against the Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions during the first half of the game at Mizzou Arena. Mandatory Credit: Denny Medley-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Arkansas-Pine Bluff completed the last domino in Missouri men’s basketball’s mid-major homestand. When you’re the worst team ranked by KenPom, a bad game must be the norm. The Tigers came into the Friday afternoon game as a 38-point favorite and walked out just under that line with a 97-61 win against the Golden Lions. After a closer-than-expected 78-67 win over Evansville Tuesday night, Mizzou had to right some wrongs before a loaded December slate that includes four teams currently ranked in the AP Top 25. The changes started even before tipoff against the Golden Lions when Mark Mitchell was announced in the starting lineup in place of Kennard Davis Jr. Mitchell hadn’t started since suffering a concussion in the opening minute against SIUE on Nov. 9. The fifth-year forward injected life into the offense with 14 points, three rebounds and three assists on 6-for-8 shooting. All of his shots came from inside the arc, an area where the Tigers saw great success. Mizzou had a dominant performance inside the arc with 50 points in the paint and shot 74.6% on two-point attempts. The interior presence also came with trips to the free-throw line. The Tigers went 24-for-27 from the charity stripe as a team. Bryson Tiller contributed nine makes on 10 attempts in what was one of his most dominant performances of the season. The Kansas transfer finished the game with 22 points on 6-for-10 shooting to go with six rebounds and four blocks. Tiller only missed one shot inside the arc. Paint success once again came at the expense of another off-night from three-point range. Jason Crowe Jr. made all three of Mizzou’s triples in a 16.7% outside shooting night as a team, and it nearly replicated that performance against the Golden Lions. The Tigers went 5-for-20 from beyond the arc after beginning the first half shooting 3-for-4 from deep. Mizzou still adopted the big brother role to UAPB from the tip by securing six points off three turnovers less than two minutes into the game. It finished the game with 23 points off 18 turnovers. Toni Bryant and Trent Pierce set the tone on multiple defensive possessions. Bryant finished the night with seven blocks and could consistently be heard throughout Mizzou Arena with his active communication. The freshman also contributed 14 points, eight rebounds and four assists. Pierce continues to struggle offensively, but he’s playable because of his defensive impact. He ended the night with four steals and a block despite only scoring two points on three shots. The Tigers still have plenty to clean up ahead of what may be their biggest test of the season to this point. They host Pittsburgh at 6 p.m. Tuesday. The Panthers are currently 8-0 and ranked 35th in KenPom.

sports.description: Shortly before the Arizona Cardinals ’ final practice of the week on Friday, Nov. 27, cornerback Max Melton took to social media to voice his latest round of frustration. “I do something to somebody?” wrote Melton, who played zero defensive snaps last week for the first time in his career. Later, inside the Cardinals locker room, Melton explained the source of his discontent. “I don't know what I did to get my time taken away,” Melton said. “I feel like I was having a really good season. That's pretty much it. I asked. I'm yet to get a clear answer. (Expletive) That was really it. I thought I was having a good season. Shooting 1000%? No way. But 90s? Yeah.” On the season, Melton has allowed 19 catches for 201 yards and two touchdowns on 33 targets, per Pro Football Focus. His passer rating when targeted is 95.6 — better than Denzel Burke, but trailing behind Kei’Tel Clark. That number had also ticked up in recent weeks. To start the season, Melton had four pass breakups in five games, performing at the highest level of any Cardinals cornerback. But over the past month, he was culpable for a handful of big plays as his snap share gradually decreased, culminating in last week’s full-time move to the bench. Melton, though, was not alone with his occasional miscues. In the final few games under Nick Rallis, few Cardinals defensive players delivered standout performances. "I haven't got a clear answer to what I've done to get removed," Melton said. "What I have to do to get back out there? I'm just sticking to a normal routine, still making plays in practice, still paying attention in meetings, still doing everything I think is right. But I don't know. I'm just kind of lost and frustrated." Melton said that he had been hoping his role would expand after the Cardinals fired Rallis this week, installing Teryl Austin as their interim defensive coordinator. So immediate change, maybe not. But I don't know. I'm just confused. I thought I was having a good season. It's frustrating.” Despite his frustration, Melton was able to impress on special teams last week, taking three kick returns for 103 yards. sports.title: Chelsea in a 'difficult moment' admits Alonso
sports.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso reacts after the 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest (Darren Staples) Xabi Alonso admitted Chelsea are in a "difficult moment" as the beleaguered boss urged his struggling side to stick together after their dismal 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest on Friday. Alonso's side crashed to a third successive Premier League loss to leave them languishing in eighth place. The Blues have lost four of their last five league matches, piling pressure on Alonso just months into his reign at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea fell behind to Igor Jesus's early opener before Morgan Gibbs-White doubled Forest's lead with a second half penalty. Emmanuel Emegha reduced the deficit but Gibbs-White struck again to make Emega's late second nothing more than a footnote on another dispiriting evening for Alonso. "It's a difficult moment for everyone. It's disappointing again to lose again but we need to keep trying to find solutions, we can't stop," Alonso said. "We are low in confidence, the team is struggling to hold a result. After getting to 2-1 we have conceded and go to 3-1. "Everything is not going our way, we are responsible for that and we are responsible to find solutions." Chelsea have already conceded 23 goals in 12 league matches and their porous defence was not helped by Alonso's curious decision to use Ecuador midfielder Moises Caicedo in a back-three. Alonso also selected Wesley Fofana after the centre-back was forced to apologise for joking in a YouTube interview about missing a penalty during Chelsea's League Cup defeat against Liverpool this season. The hapless Fofana was booed by angry Chelsea fans at the City Ground and conceded a penalty with his careless foul on former Blues striker Liam Delap. "We need to support everyone. Everyone that is in the team we need to support," Alonso said of Fofana. "We know we have to go through difficult moments. We don't take apart anyone and we want to help." Asked to assess Chelsea's dismal run, Alonso suggested the only cure was hard work on the training ground. "We can do better for sure. At this level you need to hold results and that is why we are losing in the last games," he said after Chelsea's sixth league defeat his term. "That is the only way I understand football. When things are not going well, try to work and find solutions. It can happen that we turn it around and it goes our way." Chelsea's sixth league defeat under Alonso will spark pointed questions about the former Real Madrid and Bayer Leverkusen boss. Although Alonso led Leverkusen to an historic Bundesliga title in 2024, he lasted just seven months before being sacked by Real. The former Liverpool midfielder desperately needs a win against bottom of the table Crystal Palace on Wednesday to avoid the sack talk growing even louder. "Everyone needs to stick together and go through this moment. We have to deal with it," he said. smg/bsp

sports.description: Aaron Rodgers isn’t ready to let his ugly divorce from the Pittsburgh Steelers go quietly. On Friday, the former Steelers quarterback offered another public defense of his controversial decision to air his grievances with head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show . Just one day after Tom Brady weighed in on the importance of protecting the sanctity of an NFL locker room, Rodgers offered a decidedly different perspective. This time, he delivered his message through legendary NFL broadcaster Al Michaels. That’s why I went to McAfee.” Rodgers’ comments come after he made several stunning allegations about McCarthy , including claims that the coach slept during meetings and mistakenly referred to the Steelers as the Packers during halftime of Sunday’s game. The seven-time Super Bowl champion emphasized that individual interests should never supersede what a team is trying to accomplish. Brady wasn’t alone in his criticism, as several former NFL players expressed similar concerns during Thanksgiving broadcasts. Rodgers did not specifically mention Brady in his text to Michaels, but his choice of words certainly appeared to address the growing criticism. Meanwhile, the Steelers were dominating the Broncos when Michaels shared Rodgers’ message. For McCarthy, winning football games may be the most effective response of all.

sports.description: LAFC fight for MLS Cup Playoffs survival vs. St. Louis CITY By Ari Liljenwall With their season on the line, LAFC must turn the tide in Game 2 of their Western Conference Round One Best-of-3 Series against St. Louis CITY SC . After suffering a 3-2 defeat at Energizer Park in Game 1, the Black & Gold return home to BMO Stadium on Saturday (8:30 pm ET | Apple TV ) needing a victory to force a decisive Game 3 in St. Louis on Dec. 2. Despite the series-opening setback, interim head coach Xavi Tamarit was encouraged by his team's response in recent days. “The week has been very good, a very good week of training," Tamarit told reporters Friday. “I feel the players [have] the confidence that we can do it, so that gives me a lot of confidence. “We know they are a very good team," he added. "They have a lot of weapons, but we do also. We feel that we didn't have an amazing game the other day, and we were very close to drawing at the end when, in the last 30 minutes, we started to play better.” Backs against the wall While LAFC never found an equalizer in Game 1, they showed resilience in the second half. Via tallies from Sergi Palencia and Denis Bouanga , the Black & Gold twice pulled within a goal after trailing by two, giving them something to build on heading into Saturday's must-win match. “Of course, we have to go for the win from the first [minute], but we cannot lose our organization,” Tamarit said. “We have to be intelligent. “We have to win the game in many ways, and we have to know that it's not a game that's going to finish in the 15th minute.” Despite boasting two of the league's most dangerous attackers in Bouanga and South Korean icon Son Heung-Min , LAFC know they'll need to be sharper on both sides of the ball to keep their season alive. “The talent and quality is not enough. Sometimes you need to work hard to defend,” said Bouanga, whose 85th-minute penalty-kick strike on Monday leveled him with Seattle Sounders FC 's Jordan Morris for most playoff goals (11) among active MLS players. The Gabon international also acknowledged the team's struggles to maintain their discipline when playing from behind. “When we concede one goal, we want to forget everything,” added Bouanga. Home comforts Perhaps the biggest reason for optimism is LAFC's return to BMO Stadium, where they'll have the backing of their home supporters as they look to extend their postseason run. Tamarit believes his players are eager to make amends for their Game 1 defeat. “I think the game is going to be different than the other day. sports.title: How the opening night of Nations Championship finals weekend fell flat
sports.description: It had been billed as a three-day Super Bowl of rugby but the grand opening of the Nations Championship finals weekend fell short of such lofty comparisons. Sparsely attended, bitterly cold, a few television technical gremlins – one always feared this Friday night would be a tough sell and so it proved. Not many more than 30,000 spectators made it in to watch Ireland complete a November clean sweep with victory over Australia, and far fewer for Italy’s narrow win over Fiji that preceded it. Ireland overcame Australia at a sparsely-attended Twickenham (AP) With those results came a 2-0 lead for the north in the race for the “Hemisphere Shield”, though that the organisers spent much of the night clarifying that these were not placing play-offs said plenty about a competition still yet to truly cut through. Colossal contests await over the weekend as the southern hemisphere powers seek revenge on their northern foes, but neither England vs New Zealand nor the grand final between France and South Africa is expected to draw a full house. There was an admirable effort at razzmatazz wrapped around the logistical challenges that a double-header poses – but this first of three consecutive rugby-laden days suggested an imperfect idea that requires some refinement. A neutral site detracted from, rather than enhanced, the occasion. Myles Smith provided entertainment before kick-off of Ireland against Australia (Getty) Credit to the hardy few who ventured in on a chilly winter’s night; particularly those who managed to make it in time for the Italy vs Fiji curtain-raiser. Twickenham was not exactly bouncing or buzzing pre-match – one rather felt for DJ Char Stape, who had drawn a wretched 2.30 slot in the “Fan Village”. The use of the singular was appropriate... At least the string band in the Jubel tent had a couple of heaters and canvas roof for company. Myles Smith, a Brit Award winner, was the centrepiece of the entertainment offering, with a no-doubt-pricey but enjoyable two-song set hurried in after Ireland and Australia finished their warm-ups. It is thought that future editions of this weekend, provided the six-game format is maintained, may use smaller venues for the Friday night particularly. With just a week’s notice on the actual fixtures, and a mighty number of tickets to shift, organisers should be commended for their ambition – and have a useful test case now as to what works and doesn’t. Sadly, though, the early knockings of the first helping of the double-header felt a lot like being here during the dark pandemic times. The start of the finals weekend was watched by plenty of empty seats (PA) To take a more glass – or stadium – half full approach, there was at least a spirit of conviviality. QB Brock Purdy (ankle) is ruled OUT for the 49ers’ Week 12 game against the Seattle Seahawks on Sunday, 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said. Jones has never made a start against the Seahawks, only briefly appearing in the NFC Divisional Round game last year at Lumen Field as the 49ers waved the white flag. In that garbage-time action, Jones completed two of his four passing attempts for 4 yards. Jones has served valiantly as the 49ers backup, going 5-3 as a starter last year while Purdy was out. The backup got starting reps throughout the week, so head coach Kyle Shanahan will have had the time to get Jones up to speed before the game.
